model_annotation: The plot illustrates the ratio of KV cache usage for various LLM implementations during runtime. The x-axis represents the number of tokens processed, ranging from 20 to 100, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced at intervals of 20. The y-axis represents the ratio of KV (key and value) cache usage, with a scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. A solid black line represents Vanilla\_LM, starting at a value of 100.00 and decreasing to 70.89 at 256 tokens. A dashed blue line represents StrML\_LM (n=256), beginning at 71.42 at 256 tokens and decreasing to 47.54 at 512 tokens. A solid red line represents StrML\_LM (n=512), starting at 69.67 at 512 tokens and decreasing to 43.08 at 768 tokens. A solid green line represents SepL\_LM (n=256), beginning at 77.18 at 256 tokens and decreasing to 47.36 at 512 tokens. A solid brown line represents SepL\_LM (n=512), starting at 77.18 at 512 tokens and decreasing to 47.36 at 768 tokens. A solid orange line represents SepL\_LM (n=768), beginning at 77.18 at 768 tokens and decreasing to 47.36 at 1024 tokens.
